# GroupDocs.Search for Python via .NET - examples

> On-premise SDK examples. Full-text search over Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF, OpenDocument, email, eBooks, web pages, archives and plain text, with reverse image search.

Python SDK that builds a persistent index over a folder of documents and searches it with keyword, phrase, wildcard, regular-expression, fuzzy, boolean, faceted, date-range and numeric-range queries, with synonyms, homophones, word forms and spelling correction, then highlights what was found.

## Key Features

- Index folders, files, streams and extracted data; reopen the index later, update only what changed, optimize, merge and delete
- One query language: phrases, wildcards, regular expressions, boolean operators, field (faceted) queries, date and numeric ranges, or queries built as objects
- Fuzzy, synonym, homophone and word-form search with editable dictionaries, stop words and aliases
- Highlighting of whole documents or fragments to HTML or plain text
- Events while indexing (progress, errors, passwords, skipping or tagging documents) and plain Python objects as custom text extractors, word splitters, loggers and OCR connectors
- Reverse image search over separate, embedded and archived images
- Python 3.5 to 3.14; Windows, Linux and macOS, in Docker; no Office or Acrobat needed

## Install

Until `groupdocs-search-net` 26.10.0 is on PyPI, download the wheel for your platform from https://releases.groupdocs.com/search/python-net/ and install the file:

```bash
pip install ./groupdocs_search_net-26.10.0-py3-none-win_amd64.whl
```

Once it is on PyPI:

```bash
pip install groupdocs-search-net
```

## Code Snippet

```python
from groupdocs.search import Index

index = Index("./index")            # creates the index folder, or opens an existing index
index.add("./documents")            # indexes every supported file in the folder
result = index.search("contract")
print("Found in %d documents (%d occurrences)" % (result.document_count, result.occurrence_count))
```
